description: REST API of KLARA business software, operated by ePost Service AG: accounting, invoicing, articles, customers, payroll and document delivery for Swiss SMEs. Authentication with an API key or a bearer token, and every endpoint states the permission it requires together with the KLARA roles that carry it. This repository mirrors the official documentation at developer.klara.ch in Markdown, generated from the published OpenAPI specification.
rules: There is no test environment for KLARA. Every call goes to production, so treat writing calls as chargeable and irreversible.
The rate limit is counted per calling IP address, not per API key.
Most operations require exactly one permission. Do not infer a permission from a path; each operation states its own.
